description: Test-stand hotfire (isolated_sims/Hopper_Hotfire.py). Hardware follows the test-stand P&ID: LOX and kerosene run tanks as constant-pressure reservoirs, OTV/FTV throttle valves, the main injector and regen, the torch igniter legs (OIMV/OICK/OIORF/OTHX and FIMV/FICK/FIORF) into a torch chamber and throat, and the GN2 purge system (purge regulator, purge relief valve, OPV/OPCK, FPV/FPCK, FIPV/FIPCK/FIPORF). Engine (throat, nozzle, efficiencies, chamber map, MR), fluids and the main-valve opening timing come from hopper_config.json. Same unit-suffix rules as hopper_config.json; pressures psia unless psig/psi.

simulation.note: The solver also lands on every valve and thrust-ramp breakpoint.

oxidizer.name: LOX Tank
oxidizer.note: Run tank held at a constant 1000 psia (user, 2026-11-09): no blowdown, no pressurant, no ullage.

fuel.name: Kerosene Tank
fuel.note: Run tank held at a constant 1000 psia (user, 2026-11-09).

thrust_profile.note: Ramp to 500 lbf (user, 2026-11-09). Start thrust and duration are the hopper_config.json ramp values. hold_s adds a constant-thrust hold at end_lbf. Profile time 0 is when OTV/FTV finish opening (sequence.main_valve_start_s + demand_ramp_s in hopper_config.json).

torch.note: OIMV/FIMV open and close times on the simulation clock (hopper_config.json torch values). Throat area from hopper_config torch.network. c* efficiency 1.0 is a GUESS (ideal).

purges.note: EDIT GUESS sequence: FIPV opens as the torch valves close and stays open through the burn; OPV and FPV open together once OTV/FTV are shut.

purge_supply.name: Purge Supply
purge_supply.note: EDIT GUESS ground GN2 supply upstream of the purge regulator, held constant.

purge_regulator.name: Purge Reg
purge_regulator.note: PR-REG values from hopper_config.json (set 750 psig; CdA GUESS). Ideal: outlet = min(supply, ambient + set).

oxidizer_feed.name: LOX Tank to OTV Line
oxidizer_feed.note: Copied from the vehicle (hopper_config.json); EDIT for the stand plumbing

oxidizer_feed.note: Copied from the vehicle; EDIT for the stand plumbing

torch_oxidizer_leg.note: P&ID: tees off the LOX line above OTV. All CdAs from hopper_config.json torch.network.

elements.note: Heat exchanger as a plain tube: friction-equivalent CdA, no heating or vaporization

purge_branches.note: Purge relief valve on the regulator outlet
